title: On the local equivalence of trapped-ion two-qudit gates
summary: We derive a necessary condition of the local equivalence between two-qudit gates in terms of singular values of transformed gate matrices. This condition is valid for arbitrary qudit dimensions $d$ and is thus a relatively simple general way of checking whether two gates can be reduced to one another with single-qudit (local) gates. We use this condition to investigate the local equivalence of two widely used trapped-ion two-qubit gates in qudit space: the Molmer-Sorensen (MS) gate and a special case of the Light-Shift (LS) gate, both of which we studied in one of our previous works.
